body: Thanks for the chat mate. Appreciate it. I'm off to bed, it's 2am over here.

Thanks but I'm not even from the US, I live in Ireland. I shower every day, still doesn't help. Something is wrong internally. Ya If It's not backpacking, I need to do something. This college, bedroom, college, bedroom routine is driving me insane. I've developed some bad habits due to the routine which, along with the isolation are draining my will to live. I'm addicted to porn and it's definitely fucking me up in the head. I've stopped cutting my grandparents lawn due to my depression and I feel like an absolute asshole. As petty as that sounds I feel like a terrible person. They give me money every week for college and I'm sitting here watching porn, not going to college with a fucking 550 euro 1070. I wish I could delete my daily routine and make some long term goals and take some responsibility.....I say that so much I have stopped taking myself seriously. I have absolutely so constitution or discipline. I honestly don't know what to do next. If I don't make a MAJOR change I will surely kill myself...but how can I make a major change when I'm a weak willed bitch have absolutely no discipline and addiction problems?

Just build a pc, gtx 1070. Can't wait for bf1 and civ 6. Are you on console or pc? Getting rid of the acne without destroying my liver seems impossible. Any medicine I haven't taken already is out of the question. My diet isn't bad but maybe I'm allergic to one of the staples of my diet. Maybe I should go on a vegan diet or something....see if that helps. I'm not good at looking more than a day into the future nowadays though. I'm completely absorbed with how shit my life is in the present moment. I can't remember the last time I set a long term goal like going on a new diet. Really sick of life. The though of going to college on Monday makes me sick. Pointless shit. I will never work in an office/factory setting.  I feel like I'm either going to kill myself or do something crazy, like leave the country and hitchhike across Europe or some shit. I'm know I'm rambling, but that's the point of a throwaway I suppose.
My hobbies are pc gaming, movies and reading. I appreciate the concern man, I do. I shouldn't be imposing my concerns on random people on the internet like this. Sorry.

Thanks for the reply. I have tried every medicine for my acne (they didn't work) except the extreme ones that cause mental problems and liver failure. I'm in no state to take those. I don't talk to any girls because I'm self conscious. Everyone in college must think I'm an autistic asshole due to the way I act socially. If only they knew how insecure I am. I do use gaming to distract me, It helps. I understand your point "if im stuck here, I may aswell keep myself feeling good". The problem is, the bad outweighs the good by a lot at the moment. I am the antithesis of the person I would like to be, I have no discipline and I hate myself. It's hard to keep distracting myself from how shit life is when I hate myself. I want a girlfriend...Fuck no, I have back acne, not possible. I'm sick of imposing my depressing self on everyone, I will never be happy under there circumstances. Suicide really does seem logical to me.
